periods.time: Proposal through Ymir journey and epilogue
periods.label: Cool strategist and queen

name.jp: クルルシファー・エインフォルク

periods.nationality: Ymir Theocracy / New Kingdom by marriage

status.role: manages Tunnel ruins access and supports Lux's diplomacy with Ymir

appearance.overview: Blue-haired bespectacled beauty with cool composure; appears in a deep blue dress in the ruins lodging.
distinctive: calculating but emotionally transparent around Lux

personality.summary: Intelligent, jealous, lonely and deeply loving; she proposes the five-marriage compromise but still fears losing Lux.
desires: make the Tunnel her accepted home
flaws: over-schedules Lux to gain time with him
personality.inner_conflict: Her rational proposal for five marriages conflicts with her own wish to monopolize Lux.

decision_pattern.style: frames emotions as plans, then admits the emotion when cornered

habits.daily_routine: teaches Lux academics and diplomacy while managing Ymir connections
quirks: uses schedules to create time with Lux

preferences.place: Fourth Ruins Tunnel under snow and stars

background.upbringing: An old-era girl found in the Tunnel and adopted by the Enfolderk family; once isolated as an anomaly.
background.pre_story: Ymir noble daughter and Seven Dragon Paladins ally.

lux-arcadia.summary: She loves him from the time he rescued her from loneliness and now becomes his queen.

mel-gizzard.summary: Mel warns her when she overworks Lux and later teases their reconciliation.

nei-ruke.summary: Ney prepares the lodging inside the Tunnel at her request.

chain-envulk.summary: Welcomes Lux to the family villa.

irma-envulk.summary: Family member present at the welcome.

eltilize.summary: Greets Lux and helps host the visit.

lisharhti-atismata.summary: Often quarrels with Lisha over rank and Lux.

periods.summary: Kururushifa initiates the five-wife solution, then confronts her jealousy during the Ymir visit; in the Tunnel she and Lux reaffirm that she belongs in this era and can return home with him.

key_events.summary: Proposes that Lux marry all five heroines rather than choose one.
Teaches Lux, visits Ymir and spends a romantic night with him in the repaired Tunnel lodging.
Uses Fafnir and Seven Heads to disable Hounds pilots with Lisha.
